spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Washed, cleaned, purified.
2 Bright and shining.
3 White.
n. (-तं)
Silver.
E.
धाव to make clean, affix क्त.

m. (-टः)
A bag of coarse cloth, a sack.
E.
धौत washed, and कट a mat.

n. (-जं)
Bleached or wild silk.
E.
धौत pure or washed, कोष the cocoon, and ज born.

n. (-यं)
Bleached or wild silk.
E.
धौत pure or washed, कोश a cocoon, and ढक् aff.

n. (-लं)
Crystal.
E.
धौत pure, शिला a stone.
